issues.legal_issue: Dismissal of a landholder’s reference application for delay does not prevent the landholder from seeking compensation redetermination on the basis of another landholder’s award.
material_facts: A landholder’s application for a compensation reference was dismissed as delayed and was not entertained as a reference.
Another landholder obtained an award increasing compensation for land covered by the same acquisition notification.
The landholder sought redetermination on the basis of that award.
issues.conclusion: A reference application dismissed for delay is not an effective application for a reference for this purpose; the landholder may seek redetermination if the other requirements are satisfied.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 18 and 28-A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, an application dismissed as time-barred, without being entertained and answered as a reference, does not disqualify the landholder from applying under Section 28-A. The Court applied the interpretation of Section 28-A in Union of India v. Pradeep Kumari, [1995] 2 SCC 736, including its explanation that the relevant exclusion concerns an effective reference. It also applied the principle that statutory language should be given its ordinary meaning where it is clear, while construing the beneficial provision so that a merely unsuccessful, unentertained application does not defeat its benefit.

rule.if: land_acquisition_redetermination_proceeding and reference_application_dismissed_for_delay and comparator_award_increased_compensation and land_covered_by_same_acquisition_notification and remaining_redetermination_requirements_met

predicates.land_acquisition_redetermination_proceed: A landholder seeks redetermination of acquisition compensation by relying on an award obtained by another landholder.
predicates.reference_application_dismissed_for_dela: The landholder applied for a compensation reference, but the application was dismissed as delayed rather than entertained and decided as a reference.
predicates.comparator_award_increased_compensation: A court award on another landholder’s reference granted compensation exceeding the amount fixed by the acquisition officer.
predicates.land_covered_by_same_acquisition_notific: The landholder’s land and the land underlying the comparator award were covered by the same acquisition notification.
predicates.remaining_redetermination_requirements_m: The landholder satisfies the other requirements for seeking compensation redetermination.

issues.definition: When a landholder seeks redetermination, a delayed reference application that was not entertained does not bar the request if the comparator award concerns the same acquisition and the other requirements are met; the landholder may seek redetermination.

issues.legal_issue: Receiving acquisition compensation without protest does not prevent a landholder who did not seek a compensation reference from being an aggrieved person eligible to seek redetermination.
material_facts: A landholder received the compensation awarded by the acquisition officer without protest.
The landholder did not apply for a compensation reference.
Another landholder’s reference resulted in a court award increasing compensation for land covered by the same acquisition notification.
issues.conclusion: A landholder who did not apply for a reference is an aggrieved person for this purpose regardless of whether compensation was received with or without protest, subject to the other requirements for redetermination.
issues.legal_principle: Section 28-A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 permits an interested person whose land is covered by the same acquisition notification, and who is aggrieved by the acquisition officer’s award, to seek redetermination despite not having applied for a reference under Section 18. The statutory text does not make acceptance of compensation without protest an additional disqualifying condition; imposing one would add a requirement not enacted by the legislature.

rule.if: land_acquisition_redetermination_proceeding and no_reference_application_filed and land_covered_by_same_acquisition_notification and comparator_award_increased_compensation and remaining_redetermination_requirements_met

predicates.land_acquisition_redetermination_proceed: A landholder seeks redetermination of acquisition compensation by relying on an award obtained by another landholder.
predicates.no_reference_application_filed: The landholder did not apply for a court reference concerning the acquisition officer’s compensation award.
predicates.land_covered_by_same_acquisition_notific: The landholder’s land and the land underlying the comparator award were covered by the same acquisition notification.
predicates.comparator_award_increased_compensation: A court award on another landholder’s reference granted compensation exceeding the amount fixed by the acquisition officer.
predicates.remaining_redetermination_requirements_m: The landholder satisfies the other requirements for seeking compensation redetermination.

issues.definition: A landholder who did not seek a reference is an aggrieved person eligible to seek redetermination when the comparator award concerns the same acquisition and the other requirements are met.
